[F002] Summary

Implemented F002 for plan 2026-05-22-003-feat-capability-center-v1: added a new read-only `capabilities_get_status` MCP tool in `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/mcp_server.py:266` that wraps `capabilities_status.run_status` and reuses the V0b CLI JSON envelope shape, with optional `capability_id` (returns a structured `unknown_capability` error on miss, including a "did you mean" suggestion) and optional `profile` narrowing — both fields are the only inputs the Pydantic schema (`extra="forbid"`) accepts, so any mutation/setup field is hard-refused. The handler never writes the status cache and never invokes any mutation path (a tripwire fixture enforces this), and the envelope structurally carries only token *names* (verified with a sentinel-value env-var leak test).

Added `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_capabilities_mcp_f002.py` (27 tests across tool registration, full envelope/CLI shape parity, capability_id narrowing, profile filtering, no-secret-value invariant, no-mutation invariant, JSON-RPC envelope).
